security_and_behavior: Actual authenticated principal/owner/controller is node-derived from protected caller context. No caller owner flag, principal string, role label, path, schema name or resource ID grants authority. Legacy _service local owner=True/cookie labels are not proof for canonical IPC; every public request/item/error requires current scope authentication.

Graph source vs expanded form/version/digest/ref relationships exact; node-issued graph-owned refs can identify raw invalid draft elements as well as normalized graph nodes. Invalid draft ref or graph validation success alone never creates run/resource rights.

Only dedicated GraphDraft and WorkflowTitle begin methods accept caller bytes; node chooses/verifies their exact roles. Client cannot create Catalogue/Template/Diagnostics/Metrics profiles or retag a Title ref as Graph. Canonical schema completeness and content/role validation still required at every consuming operation.

Graph staging seals exact immutable ordered bytes and profile/hash, not validity. Saving invalid source draft remains possible as data without execution. Missing canonical schema/profile refuses validation/run enablement rather than trusting legacyPython or a label. No arbitrary JSON map/value/argv/path/URL/plugin code or privateWorker DTO request escape.

Catalogue/template/validation documents redact secrets, host paths and unauthorized resource existence. Port/default/parameter strings are declarative data; tools/network/packages/worker route remain separately authorized exact node implementations, never authority from graph literal.

Workflow updates CAS exact revision/generation. Conflicting exact attempted payload/principal/revision produces same recoverable copy on identical RequestId retry; conflicting payload refuses and copies require retention/storage admission. Retried polling never creates unbounded copies.

Selection preserves source-node/source-group-subtree/source-variant-family/expanded-node form and original graph identity. Do not silently reduce raw group or sweep selection to a capped flatlist. Source profiles unresolved until canonical public selection grammar and group/sweep resolver vectors close. Resolution computes BOTH data and control ancestor closure before admission.

Submit idempotency binds immutable semantic request, source/expanded graph+workflow revision+selection meaning/principal/context. Current mutable resource admission generation is separately rechecked, not mixed into retry identity to remint work. Look up original under current authorization, refuse changed payload, never rebind an old key or repeat unknown effects.

Run original ownership is immutable; current explicit controller rights action-specific. Resume renews authority for THAT action/resources without reassigning principal or taking over a run from a label/lost session. Reconcile every exact old local/remote/reverse child/lease/result/publication before queue/unblock. Unknown effects remain interrupted/recovery_required, no replacement execution.

Cancel durable intent and terminal result have single atomic winner. CancelObserved/EOF/child exit/source state strings do not establish OS custody settlement or resource release. Late output cannot regain delivery after removal/cancel. Current state/intent/custody remain distinct truthful observations.

Artifact refs bind exact run and original node incarnation/port/manifest entry/generation/digest/size. Full original-run reuse lineage checks ownership/current authorization/fingerprint+output equality and cycles. Preserve original source auth all the way to actual artifact snapshot.

Freeze/revoke ALL writers before hash/schema validation and read/publish the SAME retained immutable snapshot. O_NOFOLLOW/regular-file/linkcount checks are useful source evidence but not complete immutability. No path reopening/TOCTOU/symlink/caller arbitraryfilename bypass. Checked range/overflow and current revocation fence on EVERY artifact page/range.

Run/log/metric data binds exact run/node/job execution incarnation. Log redaction and result separation mandatory; metrics managed document remains incomplete semantic schema, not verified measurement/admission. Missing job represented absentdoc/state, not invented success.

Frozen snapshot ID/revision/context/cursor bind actual principal/filter/resource generations and allowed itemkind. Explicit beginning/completion even empty; reauthorize each item/error and resync expired cursor. Types do not implement durable streams or access checks.

All public types remain decoded untrusted data. No casting/From/serde into native proofs, leases, worker handlers, actual principal or publication authority. Existing public Model refs reused only with matching resource meaning, never retag model asset into graph document.
